name: Martial Coup
oracle_text: Create X 1/1 white Soldier creature tokens. If X is 5 or more, destroy all other creatures.
blocked_sentences: If X is 5 or more, destroy all other creatures.

needs.what: a selector clause that drops every object recorded under an `as` binding from the pool, not just one -- so "destroy all OTHER creatures" can spare the whole set of X tokens the same spell just created
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `exclude_binding` is the closest clause, but selectors.py compares `oid == _bound_oid(ctx, name)` and `_bound_oid` returns None for the list form that `create_token`'s `as` writes, so an `exclude_binding` naming the tokens excludes nothing and the destroy kills the Soldiers it was supposed to spare. `{"binding": name}` does read the list, but only to seed a pool -- there is no negation of a binding, and selector_keys has no general `not`. `exclude_self` names the sorcery, which is not a creature and so filters nothing, and `is_token: false` is a different card: it would also spare every unrelated token on the battlefield. Reordering the destroy ahead of the create_token reaches the same final board but is a different card too -- the creatures the wrath kills never see the Soldiers enter, so `permanent_enters` triggers on them (Purphoros, Impact Tremors on a creature) fire in real Magic and would not fire here.
